actions.name: get_api_index
actions.description: Get api index (GET /). Every route this site's REST API has, with its arguments, including the ones plugins add (WooCommerce, Yoast, Jetpack...). Call those with call_api_get or call_api.

actions.name: batch_requests
actions.description: Batch requests (POST /batch/v1). Run up to 25 write requests in one go. requests: [{"method": "POST", "path": "/wp/v2/posts/1", "body": {...}}].

actions.name: create_post
actions.description: Create post (POST /wp/v2/posts). A new blog post. status: draft (the default), publish, future (with date), pending or private. content is HTML or block markup; categories and tags are lists of their ids (list_categories, list_tags).

date.description: The date the post was published, in the site's timezone.

date_gmt.description: The date the post was published, as GMT.

slug.description: An alphanumeric identifier for the post unique to its type.

status.description: A named status for the post.

password.description: A password to protect access to the content and excerpt.

title.description: The title for the post. Plain text or HTML.

content.description: The content for the post. Plain text or HTML.

author.description: The ID for the author of the post.

excerpt.description: The excerpt for the post. Plain text or HTML.

featured_media.description: The ID of the featured media for the post.

comment_status.description: Whether or not comments are open on the post.

ping_status.description: Whether or not the post can be pinged.

sticky.description: Whether or not the post should be treated as sticky.

template.description: The theme file to use to display the post.

tags.description: The terms assigned to the post in the post_tag taxonomy.

password.description: The password for the post if it is password protected.
